reasoning_content: The file already has proper interfaces. The issue is the duplicate interface definitions got added. Let me remove the appended interfaces.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Remove the appended lines (last 12 lines)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -n -12 /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts > /tmp/legend.tmp && mv /tmp/legend.tmp /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts")
print("Removed duplicates")

# Verify line count
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("wc -l /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts")
print("Lines:", stdout.read().decode())

# Rebuild
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /opt/areloria/server/dist && cd /opt/areloria/server && npx tsc 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nIndex:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
